sites.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-1-wildlife-management-areas/ ('20. Teter Creek ... On the WMA: campsites – 20 tent/trailer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Picnic area and picnic shelter on the WMA.

facilities.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-1-wildlife-management-areas/ ('On the WMA: campsites – 20 tent/trailer, vault toilets, potable water, picnic area, picnic shelter'), read 2026-10-21

note: WV DNR campground at Teter Creek Lake Wildlife Management Area, a 35-acre fishing lake (electric motors only) reached by County Route 9 from WV-92 at Meadowville, east of Philippi (Barbour County). Small-boat lake with a trail around it. --Claude
summary: WV DNR District 1 page confirms 20 tent/trailer campsites, vault toilets and potable water (sites/facilities now manual); the DNR WMA map (2022) marks a campground by the lake. Not stated: fees, reservations, season, rig size, hookups (derived electric 0 left). Owned by WVDNR, managed by Wildlife Resources Section, so ownership state stands. Note: corrected the directions (DNR: 'County Route 9 from state Route 92 at Meadowville'; the old 'off WV-26' named a Preston County road) and dropped the site count, facilities and no-hookups restatements.
flags: Criteria: DNR says only 'tent/trailer' campsites; no page gives a site length or says a 23-ft motorhome fits. No fee, booking or season information on any DNR page.

Where camping is allowed (for asks #8): the District 1 page lists 'campsites – 20 tent/trailer' on the WMA and nothing more; the WMA map's legend has a 'Campground' symbol placed by the lake. No WV rule about distance from water or facilities appears on either page.
